purpose: Server Message Block for file and printer sharing.
description: SMB operates as an application-layer network protocol mainly used for providing shared access to files, printers, and serial ports.
real_world_incidents: WannaCry and NotPetya ransomware spread globally using the EternalBlue SMBv1 exploit.

audience_guidance.student: SMB shares files on Windows. If exposed, hackers can use exploits like EternalBlue to take over the computer instantly.
audience_guidance.developer: Ensure SMBv1 is disabled in the registry. Never expose port 445 to the WAN.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Check for null sessions using smbclient or CrackMapExec. Check if SMBv1 is enabled.
audience_guidance.pentester: Run MS17-010 checks. Attempt anonymous login to list shares. Perform SMB relay attacks if signing is disabled.
audience_guidance.security_team: Monitor for lateral movement on port 445. Ensure SMB signing is enforced via GPO. Continuously audit for SMBv1.
